title: Data Science Manager, Cross-Meta Integrity (XI) Measurement

cond_0001.intro:
As a Data Science Manager at [Company name masked], you will help shape the future of the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses, creators, and partners around the world. Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team which builds, governs and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team in the Family of Apps ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes, XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will lead a multi-layered team of data scientists and partner with product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As critical members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, design cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and perform product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to drive long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work utilizes one of the largest data sets in the world and drives high-stakes outcomes that impact billions of people on and off the platform.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and shape product development to bring value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will inspire, lead and grow a world-class team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Drive analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management and across the Analytics community to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions
Inspire, lead, and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer term vision.
Actively influences the design of the strategy and shaping of the roadmap within this scope. Generate and use team insights to set and prioritize longer term goals.
Develop understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Grow analytics expertise around you, upskilling your team, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience
A minimum of 7 years of work experience (3+ years with a Ph.D.) in applied quantitative field, including 2 years of experience managing analytics teams
5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers
A minimum of 2 years of experience working on consumer facing products
Experience communicating both in low-level technical details as well as high-level strategies
Experience in cross-functional partnership among teams of Engineering, Design, PM, Data Engineering
Track-record driving product roadmap and execution
Preferred Requirements
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams
7+ Years of experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling or machine learning in the experimentation space
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
cond_0001.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
cond_0001.workplace_support: We work to create an environment where employees feel supported, heard, and able to do their best work. Our approach includes flexibility, trust, and practical support that helps people thrive across changing needs and responsibilities.

cond_0009.intro:
As a Data Science Manager at [Company name masked], you will help shape the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses, creators, and partners around the world. Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team that builds, governs, and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes — XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will coordinate a multi-layered team of data scientists and work alongside product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As central members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, collaborate on cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and contribute to product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to support long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work draws on one of the largest data sets in the world and produces high-stakes outcomes that affect billions of people on and off the platform.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and work with others to shape product development that brings value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and work with a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will work to convince and align leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and serve as a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will support, develop, and grow a team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
Coordinate analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management, and across the Analytics community to inform, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions.
Support, develop, and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer-term vision.
Collaborate on shaping the strategy and roadmap within this scope. Share team insights to help set and prioritize longer-term goals.
Work alongside others to build understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to help solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Help grow analytics expertise across the team, upskilling data scientists, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience
A minimum of 7 years of work experience (3+ years with a Ph.D.) in an applied quantitative field, including 2 years of experience managing analytics teams
5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers
A minimum of 2 years of experience working on consumer-facing products
Experience communicating both in low-level technical details and high-level strategies
Experience in cross-functional partnership among teams of Engineering, Design, PM, and Data Engineering
Track record of contributing to product roadmap and execution
Preferred Requirements
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams
7+ Years of experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling, or machine learning in the experimentation space

As a Data Science Manager at [Company name masked], you will help shape the future of the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses, creators, and partners around the world. Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team which builds, governs and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team in the Family of Apps ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes, XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will lead a multi-layered team of data scientists and partner with product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As critical members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, design cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and perform product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to drive long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work utilizes one of the largest data sets in the world and drives high-stakes outcomes that impact billions of people on and off the platform. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of integrity measurement and the data systems behind it.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and shape product development to bring value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will inspire, lead and grow a world-class team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0040.responsibilities:
Drive analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management and across the Analytics community to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions
Inspire, lead, and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer term vision.
Actively influences the design of the strategy and shaping of the roadmap within this scope. Generate and use team insights to set and prioritize longer term goals.
Develop understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Grow analytics expertise around you, upskilling your team, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0040.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience
A minimum of 7 years of work experience (3+ years with a Ph.D.) in applied quantitative field, including 2 years of experience managing analytics teams
5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers
A minimum of 2 years of experience working on consumer facing products
Experience communicating both in low-level technical details as well as high-level strategies
Experience in cross-functional partnership among teams of Engineering, Design, PM, Data Engineering
Track-record driving product roadmap and execution
Preferred Requirements
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams
7+ Years of experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling or machine learning in the experimentation space
cond_0040.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

As a Data Science Manager at [Company name masked], you will help shape the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses, creators, and partners around the world. Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team that builds, governs, and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team in the Family of Apps ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes — XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will coordinate a multi-layered team of data scientists and work alongside product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As critical members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, collaborate on cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and contribute to product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to support long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work utilizes one of the largest data sets in the world and supports high-stakes outcomes that impact billions of people on and off the platform.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and work with others to shape product development that brings value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and work with a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will support, develop, and grow a team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0234.responsibilities:
Coordinate analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management, and across the Analytics community to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions.
Support and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer-term vision.
Work alongside others to shape the strategy and roadmap within this scope. Share team insights to help set and prioritize longer-term goals.
Develop shared understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to help identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Collaborate on large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Help build analytics expertise across the team, upskilling data scientists, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0234.requirements:
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience
A minimum of 7 years of work experience (3+ years with a Ph.D.) in applied quantitative field, including 2 years of experience managing analytics teams
5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers
A minimum of 2 years of experience working on consumer facing products
Experience communicating both in low-level technical details as well as high-level strategies
Experience in cross-functional partnership among teams of Engineering, Design, PM, Data Engineering
Track-record driving product roadmap and execution
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field.
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams.
7+ Years of experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling or machine learning in the experimentation space

cond_0265.intro:
As a Data Science Manager at [Company name masked], you will help shape the future of the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses, creators, and partners around the world. Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team which builds, governs and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team in the Family of Apps ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes, XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will lead a multi-layered team of data scientists and partner with product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As critical members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, design cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and perform product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to drive long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work utilizes one of the largest data sets in the world and drives high-stakes outcomes that impact billions of people on and off the platform. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of integrity measurement and the data systems that underpin it.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and shape product development to bring value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will inspire, lead and grow a world-class team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0265.responsibilities:
Drive analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management and across the Analytics community to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions
Inspire, lead, and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer term vision.
Actively influences the design of the strategy and shaping of the roadmap within this scope. Generate and use team insights to set and prioritize longer term goals.
Develop understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Grow analytics expertise around you, upskilling your team, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0265.requirements:
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience
A minimum of 7 years of work experience (3+ years with a Ph.D.) in applied quantitative field, including 2 years of experience managing analytics teams
5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers
A minimum of 2 years of experience working on consumer facing products
Experience communicating both in low-level technical details as well as high-level strategies
Experience in cross-functional partnership among teams of Engineering, Design, PM, Data Engineering
Track-record driving product roadmap and execution
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field.
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams.
7+ Years of experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling or machine learning in the experimentation space

Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team that builds, governs, and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team in the Family of Apps ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes — XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will coordinate a multi-layered team of data scientists and work alongside product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As critical members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, collaborate on cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and contribute to product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to support long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work utilizes one of the largest data sets in the world and supports high-stakes outcomes that impact billions of people on and off the platform.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and work with others to shape product development that brings value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and work with a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will support, develop, and grow a team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0288.responsibilities:
Coordinate analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management, and across the Analytics community to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions.
Support and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer-term vision.
Work alongside others to shape the strategy and roadmap within this scope. Share team insights to help set and prioritize longer-term goals.
Develop shared understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to help identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Collaborate on large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Help build analytics expertise across the team, upskilling data scientists, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0288.requirements:
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience
A minimum of 7 years of work experience (3+ years with a Ph.D.) in applied quantitative field, including 2 years of experience managing analytics teams
5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers
A minimum of 2 years of experience working on consumer facing products
Experience communicating both in low-level technical details as well as high-level strategies
Experience in cross-functional partnership among teams of Engineering, Design, PM, Data Engineering
Track-record driving product roadmap and execution
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field.
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams.
7+ Years of experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling or machine learning in the experimentation space
cond_0288.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team which builds, governs and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team in the Family of Apps ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes, XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will lead a multi-layered team of data scientists and partner with product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As critical members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, design cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and perform product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to drive long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work utilizes one of the largest data sets in the world and drives high-stakes outcomes that impact billions of people on and off the platform. Most people become stronger in this kind of analytical and measurement work over time as they build experience and learn from the data and teams around them.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and shape product development to bring value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will inspire, lead and grow a world-class team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0329.responsibilities:
Drive analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management and across the Analytics community to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions
Inspire, lead, and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer term vision.
Actively influences the design of the strategy and shaping of the roadmap within this scope. Generate and use team insights to set and prioritize longer term goals.
Develop understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Grow analytics expertise around you, upskilling your team, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0329.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience
A minimum of 7 years of work experience (3+ years with a Ph.D.) in applied quantitative field, including 2 years of experience managing analytics teams
5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers
A minimum of 2 years of experience working on consumer facing products
Experience communicating both in low-level technical details as well as high-level strategies
Experience in cross-functional partnership among teams of Engineering, Design, PM, Data Engineering
Track-record driving product roadmap and execution
Preferred Requirements
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams
7+ Years of experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling or machine learning in the experimentation space
cond_0329.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0329.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.
cond_0329.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team which builds, governs and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team in the Family of Apps ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes, XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will lead a multi-layered team of data scientists and partner with product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As critical members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, design cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and perform product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to drive long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work utilizes one of the largest data sets in the world and drives high-stakes outcomes that impact billions of people on and off the platform.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and shape product development to bring value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will inspire, lead and grow a team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0452.responsibilities:
Drive analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management and across the Analytics community to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions
Inspire, lead, and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer term vision.
Actively influences the design of the strategy and shaping of the roadmap within this scope. Generate and use team insights to set and prioritize longer term goals.
Develop understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Grow analytics expertise around you, upskilling your team, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.
cond_0452.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering) required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in an applied quantitative field (minimum 3 years with a Ph.D.), including at least 2 years managing analytics teams.
5+ Years of proven leadership in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of people management through layers.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise working on consumer-facing products.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to operate fluently across low-level technical details and high-level strategy.
Proven track record driving product roadmap and execution.
Preferred Requirements
Master's or Ph.D. In Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field.
Deep knowledge of cross-functional partnership among Engineering, Design, PM, and Data Engineering teams.
7+ Years of demonstrated expertise in quantitative analysis, statistical modeling, or machine learning in the experimentation space.
Proven track record of leading high-performing analytics teams.

cond_0477.intro:
As a Data Science Manager at [Company name masked], you will help shape the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses, creators, and partners around the world. Cross-[Company name masked] Integrity (XI) Measurement is a central measurement team that builds, governs, and produces all of the Integrity metrics used to assess XI's progress against our mission to protect people and businesses while preserving voice and economic opportunity. These metrics are used across all of [Company name masked], whether it is an XI team goaling on their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes — XI Measurement surfaces the insights to guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will coordinate a multi-layered team of data scientists and work alongside product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill our mission. As central members of the product leadership team, our data scientists bring their expertise to define the metrics and frameworks that shape the overall priorities of our teams, collaborate on cutting-edge measurement and inventive experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and contribute to product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to support long-term strategy as well as day-to-day product development. This work draws on one of the largest data sets in the world and produces high-stakes outcomes that affect billions of people on and off the platform.
About the role:
Product leadership: You will use data to understand the product and business ecosystem, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and work with others to shape product development that brings value to people, businesses, and [Company name masked]. You will help develop strategy and support leadership in prioritizing what to build and setting goals for execution.
Analytics: You will guide product teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and work with a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will work to convince and align leaders using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and serve as a trusted strategic partner.
People leadership: You will support, develop, and grow a team of data scientists and data science leaders.
cond_0477.responsibilities:
Coordinate analytics projects end-to-end in partnership with teams from Engineering, Product Management, and across the Analytics community to inform, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions.
Support, develop, and grow a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill our longer-term vision.
Collaborate on shaping the strategy and roadmap within this scope. Share team insights to help set and prioritize longer-term goals.
Work alongside others to build understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to help solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Help grow analytics expertise across the team, upskilling data scientists, engineers, and others, to increase overall team impact.

Experience communicating both in low-level technical details and high-level strategies

These metrics are used across [Company name masked], whether by an XI team tracking their ability to limit specific types of harm or a Product team ensuring that a launch doesn't inadvertently regress integrity outcomes. XI Measurement surfaces the insights that guide team strategy and org investment. The successful candidate will lead a multi-layered team of data scientists and coordinate with product managers, software engineers, operations managers, policy experts, and other disciplines to fulfill this mission. Data scientists in this function define the metrics and frameworks that shape team priorities, design measurement approaches and experiments to put high-fidelity data behind these artifacts, and conduct product, ecosystem, and experimental analyses to support long-term strategy and day-to-day product development. This work draws on one of the largest data sets in the world and produces outcomes that affect billions of people on and off the platform.
cond_0484.responsibilities:
Drive analytics projects end-to-end, coordinating with Engineering, Product Management, and the broader Analytics community to inform and support product strategy and investment decisions.
Lead and develop a team of data scientists and manager(s) to fulfill the longer-term vision.

Develop understanding of complex distributed systems and sub-components, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify present and future risks and opportunities.
Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches.
Build analytics expertise within the team, upskilling data scientists, engineers, and others to increase overall team impact.
cond_0484.requirements:
BS degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, operations research, econometrics, computer science, engineering), or BS/MS in a quantitative discipline with equivalent working experience

5+ Years of experience in a team leadership role, including 2+ years of experience with people management through layers

Experience communicating both in low-level technical details and high-level strategies

Track record driving product roadmap and execution
